pairs: Fecit quoque altare æneum viginti cubitorum longitudinis,
Also, he made a brass altar of twenty cubits in length,
and of twenty cubits in width,
and of ten cubits in height,
Mare etiam fusile decem cubitis a labio usque ad labium,
as well as a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim,
It had five cubits in height,
et funiculus triginta cubitorum ambiebat gyrum ejus.
and a line of thirty cubits went around it on all sides.
Similitudo quoque boum erat subter illud,
Also, under it there was the likeness of oxen.
et decem cubitis quædam extrinsecus cælaturæ,
And certain engravings encircled the cavity of the sea,
quasi duobus versibus alvum maris circuibant.
along ten cubits of the outside, as if in two rows.
et ipsum mare super duodecim boves impositum erat,
And the sea itself was placed upon the twelve oxen,
three of which were looking toward the north,
and another three toward the west,
then another three toward the south,
and the three that remained toward the east,
having the sea imposed upon them.
But the posteriors of the oxen were toward the interior,
posteriora autem boum erant intrinsecus sub mari.
Porro vastitas ejus habebat mensuram palmi,
Now its thickness had the measure of the palm of a hand,
et labium illius erat quasi labium calicis,
and its brim was like the lip of a cup,
or like the outturned petal of a lily.
And it held three thousand measures.
And he placed five on the right,
et quinque a sinistris, ut lavarent in eis omnia quæ in holocaustum oblaturi erant:
and five on the left, so that they might wash in them all the things that they were to offer as holocausts.
But the priests were to be washed in the sea.
Then he also made ten gold lampstands,
et candelabra aurea decem secundum speciem qua jussa erant fieri:
according to the form by which they had been ordered to be made.
And he set them in the temple,
Moreover, there were also ten tables.
And he placed them in the temple,
and five on the left. Also,
there were one hundred gold bowls.
Then too, he made the court of the priests,
et ostia in basilica, quæ texit ære.
and doors in the hall, which he covered with brass.
Porro mare posuit in latere dextro contra orientem ad meridiem.
Now he placed the sea on the right side, facing the east, toward the south.
et complevit omne opus regis in domo Dei:
And he completed every work of the king in the house of God,
and something like a little net,
which would cover the heads above the crossbeams,
et retiacula duo ita ut bini ordines malogranatorum singulis retiaculis jungerentur,
so that two rows of pomegranates were joined to each net,
which would cover the crossbeams and the heads of the pillars.
and basins that he placed upon the bases;
and twelve oxen under the sea;
and cooking pots and hooks and bowls.
Omnia vasa fecit Salomoni Hiram pater ejus in domo Domini ex ære mundissimo.
made all the vessels for Solomon, in the house of the Lord, from the purest brass.
The king cast these in the region near the Jordan,
fudit ea rex in argillosa terra inter Sochot et Saredatha.
in the clay soil between Succoth and Zeredah.
Now the multitude of the vessels was innumerable,
so much so that the weight of the brass was unknown.
Fecitque Salomon omnia vasa domus Dei,
And Solomon made all the vessels for the house of God,
et mensas, et super eas panes propositionis:
and the tables upon which were the bread of the presence;
candelabra quoque cum lucernis suis ut lucerent ante oraculum juxta ritum ex auro purissimo:
and also, of the purest gold, the lampstands with their lamps, to shine before the oracle, according to the rite;
omnia de auro mundissimo facta sunt.
All these were made from the purest gold.
Also, the vessels for the perfumes,
and the little mortars were from the purest gold.
And he engraved the doors of the inner temple,
And the doors of the outer temple were of gold.
Sicque completum est omne opus quod fecit Salomon in domo Domini.
And so, every work was completed that Solomon made in the house of the Lord.
